notes.title: Travel through the solar system!
notes.content:
It’s your job to destroy the aliens and stop them from taking over our solar system. Each chapter represents a different wave of 10 stages of aliens, each with their own unique stage and character designs.

Chapter 1. Mercury (10 stages)
Chapter 2. Venus (10 stages)
Chapter 3. Earth (10 stages)
Chapter 4. Mars (10 stages)
 


Mercury
Starting at Mercury, you’ll mostly be learning how to play the game. The aliens are bigger, and easier to destroy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/46ad1fd55101b531467de08c4e654dfe27fb31c2.png



Venus
As you make your way to Venus and beyond, you’ll slowly come up against increasingly difficult challenges. At the same time you’ll gradually gain access to a larger variety of rackets and abilities to help you take out the oncoming waves of space aliens. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif


Earth
Welcome home, space traveller! You've still got a ways to go before you're done!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/c90b099b28d2f7b5e380f6962b6a7a93a3aea28b.png



Mars
Each planet is slightly more difficult than the one before it, with Mars being for people who are looking for a challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/ab0bdb22d515e4a43f13a16dc7718e0862fcf69c.png



Endless Mode
And if you’re still looking for a way to test your worth, you can always hop over to endless mode and see how long you can last.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/58c55e852d896e711d01c6d5d1ca763ce03d4ebf.gif

notes.title: All Kinds of Modes & Stages!
notes.content:
Protect the solar system!

Aliens have invaded the inner solar system, and it’s your job to stop them.
Starting at Mercury, and working your way to Mars, you’ll need to defeat the aliens and take out their boss on each planet.

Test your mettle with three different modes:

Campaign Mode
Start slow and build your skills against increasingly difficult stages and bosses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6ab1021220b8c70476000702fb0b56b4f6e0743f.gif


Multiplayer Mode
Play against your friends, or other players around the world in multiplayer mode!
You may think you’re good, but are you the best?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/486dbf97818f975fe1c45cfa328eb3bd68f03bf2.gif


Endless Mode
It’s not over until it’s over! Endless mode is a battle of endurance. The aliens keep coming, but can you stop them? Endless mode has two versions: “with items” & “without items”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/58c55e852d896e711d01c6d5d1ca763ce03d4ebf.gif



Improve your skills on each stage with Space Block Buster’s 3 different stage types:

Regular Stages
It’s just like the block busting games you’re used to, except this time it’s in 3D! Use buffs and avoid debuffs to defeat the space aliens!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6ab1021220b8c70476000702fb0b56b4f6e0743f.gif

Centipede Stages
The space aliens are weaving back and forth as they crawl towards you… Defeat them before they get too close!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif


Boss Stages
At the end of every stage, you’ll have to defeat the boss to move on to the next planet. Each boss has its own attacks and tricks up its sleeve, so stay on your toes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/c9d8fc1312f726cf38892d9e1b5a8817bde62439.gif

Defeat enemies and avoid asteroids while moving through space to get the highest score on the leaderboard. 
 To travel between planets (for example Mercury => Venus, Venus => Earth, Earth=> Mars) you must pass the Space Voyager stage.

notes.title: Major Update (Centipede Stage)
notes.content:
Space Block Buster: Centipede Stage Update


[Centipede Stage]


: For much more exciting play, Centipede stage that pressures the play with its own movements is added. 
Experience your nostalgic game in VR space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/667c2e020fe129cb5ae2841558922c61afd8387a.png



[Game Play]


1) 'Space Block Buster: Centipede Stage' maintains the same form as existing blocks, and can be destroyed using a ball. Since Centipede’s movement is very irregular, you need to focus as much as possible to target its head.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/a82584c10d16b8cc73beb8b4f24d319ef07728ef.gif



2) When Centipede’s head is destroyed, the body breaks down along. But when the body is destroyed while the head is undamaged, it separates into 2 or more and gives stronger pressure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif

The stage consists of 4~5 waves in total. As the stage progresses, Centipede with higher HP appears or the body is designed to destroy easily.


3) Centipede turns into a Bullet Block when it reaches a certain area, and begins to attack. The number of close blocks must be reduced as much as possible. As the more close blocks you have, the more simultaneous attacks you will receive. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fe758683294f561780937658744a300c43628204.gif



[Score Initialization, Lobby UI Improvement]


: 4 chapters of Space Block Buster has 10 stages each, and Centipede replaces 2 stages of each chapter. This will initialize some of the existing stage's scores, and players can earn points by playing the Centipede stage.

Stages that include Centipede has different icon background from existing stages, which makes it easier to distinguish.
(1-4, 1-8, 2-4, 2-8, 3-4, 3-8, 4-4, 4-8 Stage)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6017a7be3d013f617d85038d7b09d941985732f8.png

notes.title: Major Update (Multiverse Mode)
notes.content:
Multiverse Mode has been added through the update.
Multiverse Mode is a PVP mode that allows you to compete against other players and compare your game skills with opponents.

[Round Configuration]
Multiverse Mode consists of a total of 3 rounds. The time of each round, the number of blocks and the HP of the blocks will gradually increase, and the player can use the item to remove the block faster than the opponent or eliminate the opponent using the attack item to win the game.

During each round, a warm-up time of less than 5 seconds is given, and information on items that will appear in that round is announced. It is recommended for players to check this before taking on the stage, or plan to eliminate opponents. Of course, it is also possible to use the warm-up time to provoke or mock the opponent next to you. There are no restrictions on enjoying space sports, except for foul play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/486dbf97818f975fe1c45cfa328eb3bd68f03bf2.gif

[Description of Additional Items]
Attack items that can only be used in Multiverse Mode have been added.

1. Boxing Glove changes the opponent's racket into a boxing glove.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f25b37c28fbb7cd3ae6750df1d831c626646e293.png

2. Acoustic Guitar changes the opponent's racket into an acoustic guitar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/9f61591ad57a9f8b9c12536afd160a4b9e75370a.png

3. Broom Stick changes the opponent's racket into a broom.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/d64bf29bf5d768909bc3b7edbadafff63fbcecb8.png

4. Speed Up increases the opponent's ball speed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/1c94f78e1303e24b0c54be1fbafde851df3a7033.png

5. Little Pong makes the opponent's ball small.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/5925fd99488dd16d4ef7895377740010667fd3a8.png

You must use the new items added to interfere with your opponent's game. Interference will be applied to the opponent in the direction of the racket used to acquire the item. Players who are affected by the item effect should not panic and prepare by checking the countdown that appears before the effect begins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/a49bc9974629560c84e4b334161f67b5d10fd04c.gif

[Tip]
You can play normally even if your opponent accidentally loses their life and is out of the round first. Using this time to get the most points is critical to winning. Conversely, a 'perfect round' happens if someone first removes all the blocks spawned on the stage. If someone achieves a perfect round, the round ends immediately and the next round begins. In other words, the key to victory is to achieve a perfect round or to interfere and get the opponent out.

notes.title: The First Update (New Chapter, Items, Boss, Mode)
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone!
We bring you the extremely welcome news of Space Block Buster's first update.
A new stage and mode, as well as many new items, have been added!!

1. Stages
1) Chapters 3 Updates

The block pattern of each stage in Chapter 3 was changed
New items and a new block added
: When the block approaches a player and reaches a certain distance, the block will not be able to suppress its anger and will fire towards the player. This is called a Bullet Block.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/46588ea8d22f58ec4b8b45dffef1f90013c19f97.gif
  
2) New chapter added (Chapter 4)

 Added new chapter set called Mars
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/ab0bdb22d515e4a43f13a16dc7718e0862fcf69c.png


3) New boss added (Chapter 4 boss: Moai)

 Skill: Some of the blocks that are currently created change to Bullet Blocks and fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/1b5f81f8484812792a2bba06272ddeae6ac7e50a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/c9d8fc1312f726cf38892d9e1b5a8817bde62439.gif


4) New mode added to Endless mode 

 Added Endless mode with no items

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/86dac88b858781c8ec195f7d193bd5cc148f0d9a.png


2. Items
1) 2 new items added

 Lightsaber

: It can deal with Bullet Blocks flying towards the player by slicing them.
 (But it also splits balls and changes them into 2 Little Pongs. Appears after Chapter 4)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f627365c13401c176f4d1ec1e32057a2da85829a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/bb89830ca9c5f09627a5f9f0bb9b411e07b21c43.gif


 Pulling Gun

: You can catch a ball and fire it in the direction you want. (Appears after Chapter 4)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/2975c656e456d6a4dbee6ff810d39e9f588b4f8e.gif



2) 3 new rackets / balls / spawner added 
: Racket / Ball / Spawner with various skins received when achievement is accomplished

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/96b3ccf4339162f650c790a2db160b9dab7fc723.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/e74e1662a85eabf99fefaa5367926244fab292eb.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6ab1021220b8c70476000702fb0b56b4f6e0743f.gif

 Lightning Racket
 
: Can be used when 'Is this your first time on Venus?' achievement (Clear 2-1 Stage) accomplished

 Magic Racket

: Can be used when 'How is the weather in Korea?' achievement (Clear 3-1 Stage) accomplished

 Chainsaw Racket

: Can be used when 'Mariner 4' achievement (Clear 4-1 Stage) accomplished

 Lightning Ball

: Can be used when 'Beyond Venus!' achievement (Clear Chapter 2 boss without using up life) accomplished

 Magic Ball

: Can be used when 'Beyond Earth!' achievement (Clear Chapter 3 boss without using up life) accomplished

 Chainsaw Ball

: Can be used when 'Beyond Mars!' achievement (Clear Chapter 4 boss without using up life) accomplished

 Lightning Spawner
 
: Can be used when 'Blockbuster!' achievement (First Bust) accomplished

 Magic Spawner

: Can be used when 'For a burst master' achievement (at least 2 Busts in one Stage) accomplished

 Chainsaw Spawner

: Can be used when 'Burst, burst and burst!' achievement (50,000 points in Endless mode) accomplished



3. System

1) Bullet Block added (Chapter 3, Chapter 4)
   : The block in the front most row fires at the player. The player must break the Bullet Block with a racket. (If you miss the Bullet Block, you lose a life)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/7bd78814ac42f0a9130c42316fcc23fb8f3a608e.gif

2) Inventory
   : Rackets, Balls, Spawners, etc. you've obtained can be stored/equipped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/9420d8241a511d31b37e6e394a65c6c78eb09ec2.gif

3) Other

 Endless mode theme improvements

: Improved stage theme change after Bust

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/58c55e852d896e711d01c6d5d1ca763ce03d4ebf.gif

 Improved Lobby depiction

: Added depiction of the planet changing whenever a chapter is selected

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/e6b3630c674022539dbacdecfa000fd4979cf148.gif

 Added Lobby Announcements
